summary: Short quiet residential kerb at a bend; homes 12-17 m away, mild slope.
reasons: Quiet residential street, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13-17 m away on the same side; tree cover and the bend screen some views.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a narrow sealed street; a van fits at the kerb with a bit of shoulder.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit signs Mon-Fri; only one or two cars parked nearby.

flags: Homes within 25 m on own side
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the kerb, mainly from the east and north.

best_section.where: Eighth Avenue west kerb at the bend, near the far end
